title: review-freeze-fingerprint --write silently freezes the process cwd's repository even when the manifest path belongs to another worktree
outcome: review-freeze-fingerprint --write silently freezes the process cwd's repository even when the manifest path belongs to another worktree
acceptance: scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs --write and --check refuse with a clear message when the manifest path's owning worktree (its git dir) differs from the repository the script would fingerprint (the process cwd's worktree), instead of writing a manifest that binds a different tree
A test in scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.test.mjs covers the mismatch (cwd = main checkout, manifest under .git/worktrees/OTHER) and the normal case
